## What you asked for

Paste the request. If it contained private material, describe it instead.

## What the skill did

## What was wrong

Be specific. "It felt generic" is not actionable. "The scene gate passed a scene where nothing changed
because the model counted an emotional shift as a state change" is.

## What you expected

A sentence or a short fragment is enough.
